Script: app.open("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe Illustrator 2026/Presets/en_US/Brushes/Borders/Borders_Indigenous.ai"), doc.brushes.getByName("African").applyTo(pathItem) on a path in that document, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the brush arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Two wobbly orange-ochre zigzag rails (darker outer, lighter inner) around a white strip of black dots.

cards.name: Aztec
cards.summary: Pattern border brush: a khaki / olive-tan band with heavy black edges, filled with red and lavender-grey step-spiral (fret) glyphs and small cream squiggles. Mesoamerican-inspired, ornate. (Thumbnail: the brush applied by script to a 300 pt S-curve with a 1 pt stroke in its library document, not a shipped preview.)
use_for: adventure, travel or history poster frames
avoid: content about a specific culture: it is a generic stylised motif; use authentic reference art
small sizes: the glyphs turn to noise
rectangle corners and tight bends unchecked: the render shows only the side tiles on a gentle curve, so check corner tiles and tile stretching on the real shape before shipping

cards.name: Byzantine
cards.summary: Pattern border brush: a narrow fringe of small triangles in two rows, a mustard-gold row and a pink / coral row of teeth with white triangles between. Reads as a fine dentil / sawtooth trim. (Thumbnail: the brush applied by script to a 300 pt S-curve with a 1 pt stroke in its library document, not a shipped preview.)
use_for: fine ornamental trim on invitations or certificates
inner rule inside a wider ornamental border
avoid: small artwork: the teeth blur together
content about Byzantine art itself: it is a generic sawtooth, not a Byzantine mosaic
rectangle corners and tight bends unchecked: the render shows only the side tiles on a gentle curve, so check corner tiles and tile stretching on the real shape before shipping
